UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Operator workspace root document anchoring private trading qualification and remediation records. Contains no PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

paperStartDate.description: ISO date when the 60-day paper qualification window began.

targetQualificationDays.description: Target number of verified paper trading days before live capital deployment (default 60).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was last updated.

RemediationTaskState.title: RemediationTaskState
RemediationTaskState.description: Cloud-persisted completion state and operator notes for a Project-TITAN audit remediation task.

taskId.description: Canonical Project-TITAN audit task identifier (e.g. REM-001).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

note.description: Optional verification note or PR reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated.

QualificationEntry.title: QualificationEntry
QualificationEntry.description: Daily paper trading qualification checkpoint tracking net-of-cost performance and fail-closed guard integrity.

entryId.description: Document ID matching the ISO trading date.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

equityUsd.description: End-of-session paper account equity in USD.

slippageCostUsd.description: Estimated commissions, spread drag, and statutory friction in USD.

guardTripsCount.description: Count of fail-closed guard halts during the session.

allGuardsNominal.description: Whether all 4 sleeves passed fail-closed pre-flight invariants.

notes.description: Operator session notes or anomaly summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated.

CloudAuditLog.title: CloudAuditLog
CloudAuditLog.description: Immutable append-only cloud audit trail of operator risk controls, pre-flight runs, and order actions.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

level.description: Severity level of the audit event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when audit entry was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Private operator workspace root document (strictly owner-scoped, no PII).

/users/{userId}/remediationTasks/{taskId.description: Cloud-synced Project-TITAN remediation checklist status documents.

/users/{userId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable cloud audit trail for trading terminal actions.
